This is a list of annual events and competitions in the Soundboard Prank Calling Community.

Arnold Fest (2007-)

See: List of Arnold Fest calls

Arnold Fest is an annual event held by the Soundboard Prank Calling Community in celebration of Arnold Schwarzenegger's birthday (July 30). The original Arnold Fest was hosted by Realm of Darkness from 2007 to 2014, when the website removed its prank calls. As a result, many Arnold Fest calls were lost with the exception of those uploaded to YouTube by fans and pranksters.

In recent years, Arnold Fest has been held independently on YouTube. Since 2016, Gapehorner spearheaded an effort to revive the competition. As a result of his efforts, Arnold Fest '18 boasted a record 18 entries. As with RoD, however, a number of entries on YouTube have also been lost due to pranksters closing their accounts.

Duncan Fest (2008-2009; 2011-2017)

See: List of Duncan Fest calls

Duncan Fest is an annual prank calling event held by the Soundboard Prank Calling Community in honor of Duncan. Inspired by the popular Arnold Fest competition, it is the community's second oldest event having been held annually since 2008, with the exception of 2010 and 2018.

The original Duncan Fest was hosted by YouTube prankster Dizeestl.
